checks.text: The page displays the heading "Tally Counter".
Clicking the button labeled "Add" increments the counter display from "0" to "1".
Entering "10" in the field labeled "Daily Goal" and clicking "Save" updates the progress indicator to show "1/10".
Clicking the button labeled "Reset" changes the counter display from "1" to "0" and updates the progress indicator to "0/10".
Clicking the tab labeled "History" displays a list containing the text "Today: 1".
In the "History" tab, clicking the button labeled "Clear History" removes the entry "Today: 1" and displays the text "No history yet".
In the "History" tab, the heatmap component displays a cell with the title attribute "Today: 1".
In the "History" tab, the trend chart displays a data point with the value "1".
Reload keeps the counter value "1" and the daily goal "10" visible in the main view.
